title: Extremophiles
description: Life at the edges: boiling vents, frozen vacuum, radiation. Unlocks tardigrade cultures.

puzzle.goal: A reaction proceeds only when molecules reach a short-lived activated complex at the top of the energy barrier. Treat that complex as in equilibrium with the reactants and let it fall apart at the universal frequency kB·T/h, with a transmission coefficient κ. Write the rate constant in terms of the activation enthalpy and activation entropy (molar).
puzzle.name: Eyring–Polanyi equation (transition-state theory)
puzzle.form: κ * kB * T / h * exp ( Δ * S / R ) * exp ( - Δ * H / ( R * T ) )
puzzle.expr: κ * kB * T / h * exp ( ΔS / R ) * exp ( - ΔH / ( R * T ) )
puzzle.ask: Find the rate constant of an enzyme in a hyperthermophile living at 121 °C (394 K).

vars.\u0394: change on reaching the activated complex

puzzle.method: Write the equilibrium constant for forming the activated complex as exp(−ΔG/RT) with ΔG = ΔH − TΔS, and multiply by the rate at which the complex crosses the barrier.
